kinetic_fitting.name: Photocatalytic Kinetic Model Optimization
kinetic_fitting.description: Develop and refine a kinetic model for photocatalytic water oxidation using Ru(bpy)3²⁺. Your goal is to find a reaction network that: 1) Fits individual experimental O2 evolution curves well (low RSS, high R²), 2) Reproduces phenomenological trends: [Ru] dependence (rate increases to max ~5-10 µM, then decreases), [S2O8] dependence (monotonic increase with saturation), Irradiance dependence (linear relationship), 3) Is physically meaningful (quantum yields 0-1, reasonable rate constants). CONTEXT: The [Ru] dependence curve suggests catalyst inhibition at high concentrations, which often indicates formation of inactive species or aggregation. Consider mechanisms like: dimerization of oxidized catalyst species, formation of inactive dimers/oligomers, or competitive binding. The initial network provides basic photochemistry - you should expand it by adding reactions that could explain concentration-dependent inhibition. Use the available tools to analyze fits, modify the reaction network, and evaluate performance. Focus on maximizing the overall phenomenological trend score. Please add reversible reactions as two separate reactions since the symbol <-> is not supported. Also, do not duplicate species names and remove added reactions and k_ranges that make the predictions much worse than your initial results. For any reactions that lead to deactivation consider wide ranges of the constants, could also be in the lower range.
kinetic_fitting.submission_format: Final score based on phenomenological trend reproduction (target: >0.75)
